title: Parikshaa content: MCQ or numeric question (aptitude, CS quiz, language output-predict, design concept)
description: One question with options (or a number to type), and its worked explanation. See docs/content/CONTENT-FORMAT.md section 6.

section.x-db: library_questions.section is coarser (aptitude, cs, programming, dsa, sql); the full value goes in tags.

topic.description: e.g. percentages, time-and-work, syllogism, seating, reading-comprehension, tcp, paging.

variants.description: With variants, a solver is required: it computes the answer and options for each set.

passage.description: Reading comprehension or a data set several questions share (same id).

explanation.description: EDITORIAL-STYLE section 5, aptitude: ### Understand, ### Plan, ### Solve, ### Check (why each wrong option is wrong).
explanation.x-db: practice_problems.editorial (opens after a right answer or 3 wrong ones)

distractors.description: For each wrong option (by index): the mistake that leads to it.

shortcut.description: A faster way, when one is honest (aptitude).

solver.description: Python 3. Reads a JSON object of parameter values on stdin ({} when there are no variants). Prints one line of JSON: {"answer": <the right option's exact text, or the number>, "values": {<derived numbers the stem, options or explanation show as {{name}}>}}. With variants, the options and explanation use {{name}} for what changes per set.

images.x-needs-platform: Image files inside a ZIP bundle, uploaded by the importer.
